content.value: Nur, a graduating senior has accumulated an impressive file of test during his college career. But now, he needs to sell his test collection to obtain money for his impending mariage. Three wealthy friends express interest in buying some of the tests. Nur determines that their individual demand equations are as follows:
Q1=50.00-2.00 P Q2=22.50-1.75 P Q3= 27.50-1.25 P Where the quantity subscripts denote each of the three friends and price is measured in dollars per test.

Ques : What is the market demand equation for Nur's test and how many more test can he sell for each one dollar decrease in price? If he has a file of 60 tests, what price would be charge to sell his entire collection?
